text:
Sara: Quick question — prospect wants a staged upfront schedule: 40% on signature, 60% after go-live (they want Net60 on the second invoice). Can we approve? SOW will include SLA.
Mike: how big is the contract value? and reason for staged?
Sara: $420k ARR, 1yr term. They have procurement rules — prefer smaller initial cash outlay, will accept milestone billing tied to go-live. POC ends in 6 weeks.
Jamal: POC -> pilot -> prod timeline looks like: POC 4w, pilot 8w, prod go-live around week 14. Go-live acceptance criteria are standard smoke tests + usage threshold.
Zoe: Finance note — Net60 is outside standard Net30. We do exceptions but need credit approval and AR holds. Who owns credit check?
Mike: RevOps can run credit check, but need PO or signed MSA first. Also we need to confirm bank details for ACH or escrow if they want longer terms.
Oliver: Legal — SLA in SOW ok, but staged payment language must map to invoicing schedule. If second invoice is Net60, we need to confirm service risk (we prefer Net30). Also need to confirm data residency and indemnities before sign.
Kelsey: @DealDesk Bot can you outline required approvals for a Net60 second invoice with 40% upfront?
DealDesk Bot: Rules check: Any >45 days term requires Deal Desk review + Finance + Legal sign-off. For >Net45, VP Sales approval required when ARR >= $250k. Please provide: final MSA, SOW invoice schedule, customer entity name, and credit report (or trade refs).
Sara: Copying what I'll drop into the approval request: invoice schedule snippet below. Can someone confirm this wording?
Sara: ```
Invoice 1: 40% of total, due on signature.
Invoice 2: 60% of total, invoiced on go-live acceptance; payment due Net60 from invoice date.
```
Zoe: That wording is fine, but finance needs: (1) PO number if they issue it, (2) payment method (ACH/ wire), (3) credit check result. If credit shows >B risk, we need escrow or upfront 60%.
Oliver: Also add "Payment obligation is not contingent on customer post-implementation performance beyond acceptance tests" — keeps us safe if they try to delay payment for product adoption.
Jamal: From a technical runbook perspective, go-live acceptance will be: 1) 10k daily active tokens for 7 days OR 2) smoke tests pass + SRE signoff. Pick whichever the customer meets first. Put that in SOW.
Kelsey: I'll route to VP for approval after we attach credit check. VP likes one of these mitigations: (a) signed PO + Net60 for second invoice, (b) escrow account for 60% held until 30 days post-go-live, or (c) change to Net30. Which does the customer prefer?
Sara: They're pushing hard for Net60. Escrow might be acceptable but will slow legal. They can provide trade refs quickly.
Mike: I'll kick off the credit check now and add ACH details to the request. ETA 24-48h.
DealDesk Bot: Pre-approval checklist created: docs needed: MSA (signed), SOW with acceptance language, invoice schedule, credit report, PO (if available). Tagging @Kelsey for VP sign-off after items are attached.
Zoe: If credit is clean we can approve Net60 for second invoice with the condition: payment method = wire/ACH and finance hold lifted after 1st invoice clears. If credit is borderline, require escrow or move to 60% upfront.
Oliver: I'll draft a short addendum to the SOW with the acceptance criteria + payment clause and share in thread.
Sara: thanks all — I'll upload MSA and SOW draft here tonight and attach the credit check when Mike posts it. tagging final items to close this: @DealDesk Bot please leave an approval placeholder for VP Sales. :thumbsup:
Kelsey: Sounds good. If credit clears we'll proceed with Net60 second invoice; otherwise propose fallback 30%/70% Net30. Keep me posted.
Mike: Credit check done (quick pass). I'll upload report and their trade ref emails.
DealDesk Bot: VP approval requested (auto-notify): Approver=@Kelsey.
Kelsey: Approved conditional on finance hold terms (wire/ACH required, payment remittance details on file). Approving with condition: Finance to confirm when hold is lifted.
Zoe: Finance confirms hold will be lifted after invoice 1 clears. We'll send ACH instruction request to customer.
Oliver: Addendum posted to thread and linked to draft SOW. All redlines minimal.
Sara: Great — final plan: Invoice 1 = 40% due on signature; Invoice 2 = 60% invoiced at go-live, payment Net60; Finance hold until Invoice 1 clears; ACH required; Legal addendum attached. Moving to signature. :tada:
Kelsey: Nice work team, will mark as approved in Deal Desk and notify AE to sign.
DealDesk Bot: Thread closed — conditionally approved. Reminder: keep documents in SFDC and attach credit report.
Sara: will do, thanks everyone!
